trust_decision.summary: The store base URL (CC_STORE_URL, used in password-reset links) is taken from includes/global.inc.php standard_url instead of the request Host header, decided in ini.inc.php; Config::set refuses to write standard_url/cookie_domain. This protection is ALREADY PRESENT at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: Password reset link is built there from CC_STORE_URL; the advisory summary is about reset link poisoning.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown - the published fix commit contains no source change; the source fix (ini.inc.php pin, Config::set guard, settings unset, upgrade script) is already in the pinned tree.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Store installed under a subpath / setup mode still needs a derived URL when global.inc.php has no standard_url (fallback to Host-derived $url)

O7_producer.where: ini.inc.php:123-134 (global.inc.php load) and classes/config.class.php:60-90 ($glob merged over DB config)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is exactly the pre-fix state of the code; would need reverting the real source fix that landed before the pinned commit.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Save/reload route: admin settings save (admin/sources/settings.index.inc.php:197-198) and Config::set whole-array writes would reintroduce a writable value.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second place that resolves a store domain from the request; a maintainer might use HTTP_HOST directly here.
